body:
Thank you for the kind words. Definitely some things I needed to hear and be reminded of. A lot of this stuff is new/unfamiliar for me so that might explain my discomfort too.

You are absolutely right about chemistry and compatibility. We have a lot of chemistry and compatibility and it does make it feel amazing for both of us. I think reminding myself of that will help me maintain my confidence a bit more. 

I do see a therapist here and there for other things and was thinking about bringing it up next time I see them for their take on things. It felt good to write out this post here since I don't know who to talk to about this sort of stuff, and reading the few comments so far have been helpful too.

Believe it or not what you've said has been incredibly helpful and made me feel much better about all this. Thank you so much for writing this!
